extraction.Name: Alfred Bordeaux
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded by the Farmers State Bank of Colome April 21, 1920
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged by Bordeaux and wife dated March 1, 1921 for $2080.00, and another mortgage May 17, 1922 for $2000.00; deed dated May 2, 1923 conveyed the land to L. Yancey for a consideration of $3200.00, subject to a mortgage of $2000.00, which the grantee assumes and agrees to pay
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612667 issued; southeast quarter of section 4, township 35, range 31; also south half of the southwest quarter and south half [description appears incomplete in document]; receipt for patent signed by allottee January 23, 1918
